questions.question: The diagonal of a square is 14 cm. What will be the length of the diagonal of the square whose area is double of the area of first square?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Diagonal of square = 14 cm

**FORMULA USED:**

Area of square = ½ (diagonal)²

**CALCULATION:**

Let area of 1st square = A, diagonal = d = 14

Area of 2ⁿd square = 2A, diagonal = x

⇒ A = (1/2) d² ----(1)

According to the question,

⇒ 2A = (1/2) x² ----(2)

Divide equation 2 by equation 1

⇒ x²/14² = 2

⇒ x² = 196 × 2

⇒ x = 14√2

**∴ The length of the diagonal of second square is 14√2. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Area of square = (1/2)Diagonal²

Area of first square = (1/2)14²

⇒ 98 cm²

According to the question,

2 times of area of first square = (1/2)x²

x = diagonal of second sqaure

⇒ 2 × 98 = (1/2)x²

⇒ x = 14√2 cm 

∴ The length of the diagonal of second square is 14√2.

questions.question: The Least Common Multiple and Highest Common Factor of two numbers are 60 and 3 respectively. If their difference is 3, then what will be the sum of these two numbers?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

L.C.M. = 60

H.C.F. = 3

Difference in numbers = 3

**FORMULA USED:**

L.C.M. × H.C.F. = product of numbers

**CALCULATION:**

Product of numbers = 60 × 3 = 180

Difference = 3

→ Numbers are 12 and 15 (Since 12 × 15 = 180, satisfies the condition)

→ Sum of numbers = 12 + 15 = 27

questions.question: Four numbers are in the ratio of 2 : 5 : 3 : 8 respectively. If the sum of these four numbers is 432, then what is the sum of first and fourth number?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Four numbers are in the ratio of 2 : 5 : 3 : 8

Sum of these four numbers is 432

**CALCULATION:**

Let the four numbers be 2x, 5x, 3x, 8x

Sum of four numbers = 18x = 432

⇒ x = 432/18 = 24

Sum of 1st and 4th number = 10x

⇒ 240

**∴ The sum of first and fourth number is 240.**

questions.question: The total weight of 12 boys and 8 girls is 1080 kg. If the average weight of boys is 50 kg, then what will be average weight of girls?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Total weight of 12 boys and girls is 1080 kg.

Average weight of boys is 50

**FORMULA USED:**

Weighted avg = (n₁ × average of n₁ quantity + n₂ × average of n₂ quantity + ----)/(n₁ + n₂ +------)

**CALCULATION:**

Total weight of boys and girls = 1080 kg

Average weight of boys = 50 kg

Let avg weight of girls be y

50 × 12 + 8 × y = 1080

⇒ 8y = 1080 - 600

⇒ 8y = 480 

⇒ y = 60 

**∴ Average weight of girls is 60 kg **

questions.question: The length of platform is double of the length of train. Speed of the train is 144 km/hr. If train crosses the platform in 30 seconds, then what is the length of the platform?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Length of platform = Length of train × 2

Speed of train = 144 km/hr

Time taken to cross the platform = 30 sec

**CONCEPT:**

The time taken to cross the platform is equal to sum of length of train and length of platform divided by speed of train.

**FORMULA USED:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**CALCULATION:**

Speed of train = 144 km/hr = 144 × 5/18 = 40 m/sec

Distance covered in 30 sec = 40 × 30 = 1200 m

Let length of train = x m

⇒ Length of platform = 2x

⇒ 3x = 1200 Þ x = 400

⇒ Length of platform = 2x = 800m

**∴ The length of the platform is 800 m**

questions.question: The ratio of number of children, women and men in colony is 6 : 4 : 3 respectively and the colony has at least 200 members. What will be minimum number of children in the colony?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

The ratio of the number of children, women, and men in a colony is 6: 4: 3 respectively.

The colony has at least 200 members

**CALCULATION:**

Ratio = 6 : 4 : 3

Let children, women, and men be 6x, 4x, and 3x respectively.

Total member = 13x

So, members should be multiple of 13.

∴ We have to find the least multiple of 13 greater than 200. (∵ minimum number of children in the colony is asked)

As 13 × 16 = 208 there are a total of 208 members

⇒ 13x = 208 or x = 16

⇒ minimum number of Children = 6 × 16 = 96

**∴ 96 will be minimum number of children in the colony.**

questions.question: The selling price of the first article is ₹ 470 and the cost price of the second article is ₹ 470. If there is a loss of 20% on the first article and a profit of 20% on the second article, then what will be the overall profit or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Selling price of first article is ₹ 470.

Cost price of second article is ₹ 470.

Loss of 20% on first article

Profit of 20% on second article

**CONCEPT:**

Total loss/gain = (C.P. of all article – S.P. of all article)

**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = C.P. (1 + gain%/100)

S.P. = C.P. (1 - loss%/100)

**CALCULATION:**

There is loss of 20% on first article

S.P. of 1st = Rs. 470

C.P. of 1st = 470/.8 = 587.5

Similarly, S.P. of 2ⁿd = 470 × 1.2 = 564

Total C.P. = 587.5 + 470 = 1057.5

Total S.P. = 470 + 564 =1034

Loss = 1057.5 – 1034 = 23.5

Loss% 23.5/1057.5 = 2.2%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Selling price(SP) of the first article is ₹ 470, loss 20%

The cost price(CP) of first article = SP × 100/(100 - 20)

⇒ CP of first article = 470 × 100/80 = Rs. 587.5

The cost price of the second article is ₹ 470, Sell at 20% profit

⇒ SP = CP(100 + profit)/100

⇒ 470 × (100 + 20)/100

⇒ Rs. 564

Total CP = 587.5 + 470 = 1057.5

Total SP = 470 + 564 = 1034

Loss % = (CP - SP)100/CP = (1057.5 - 1034)100/1057.5

⇒ 2350/1057.5

**⇒ 2.22%**

questions.question: P and Q together can complete a work in 20 days. If P alone can complete the same work in 36 days, then in how many days Q alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

P and Q together can complete a work in 20 days

P alone can complete same work in 36 days.

**CONCEPT:**

We will use L.C.M. approach

**CALCULATION:**

Let work be L.C.M. of 20 and 36 i.e. 180 units

P and Q together work in one day = 180/20 = 9 units

P work in one day = 180/36 = 5 units

→ Q work in one day = (9 – 5) = 4 units

→ So, time taken by Q to complete work = 180/4 = 45 days.

questions.question: Teena, Reena and Sheena start a business with investment of respectively ₹ 24000, ₹ 28000 and ₹ 20000. Teena invests for 8 months, Reena invest for 10 months and Sheena invests for one year. If the total profit at the end of year is ₹ 25810, then what is the share of Teena?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Teena, Reena and Sheena start a business with investment of respectively ₹ 24000, ₹ 28000 and ₹ 20000

Teena invests for 8 months, Reena invest for 10 months and Sheena invests for one year.

Total Profit = 25810

**Concept:**

Ratio in which profit divides = Sum of money invested by individual × Duration for which money is invested.

**Calculation:**

Ratio in which profit divides = 24000 × 8 : 28000 × 10 : 20000 × 12

⇒ Ratio = 24 × 8 : 28 × 10 : 20 × 12

⇒ Ratio = 24 : 35 : 30

Share of Teena 

⇒ 25810 × 24/(24 + 35 + 30)

⇒ 25810 × 24/89

⇒ 290 × 24

⇒ Rs. 6960

**∴ The share of teena is Rs. 6960.**

questions.question:
What is the median of the given data?

1, 3, 6, 2, 5, 8, 3, 8, 2
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A data having numbers: 1, 3, 6, 2, 5, 8, 3, 8, 2

**CONCEPT:**

Median is in the middle of series if arranged in ascending or descending order.

**FORMULA USED:**

Middle term in case total terms(n) are odd = (n +1)/2

Median = ((n + 1)/2)th term

Middle term in case total terms are even = n/2, n/2 +1

Median = ((n/2)th term + (n/2 +1)th )/2

**CALCULATION:**

Arranging in ascending order

1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 5, 6, 8, 8

Total no of terms = 9 (odd)

⇒ Median = (9 + 1)/2 = 5th term = 3

**∴ The median is 3.**

Average Speed = Total Distance/Total time

questions.question: The average weight of all the vehicles in a parking is 4000 kg. The average weight of 12 vehicles is 6000 kg. Average weight of the remaining vehicles is 3000 kg. What is the total number of vehicles in the parking?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Average weight of all the vehicles in a parking is 4000 kg

Average weight of 12 vehicles is 6000 kg

Average weight of the remaining vehicles is 3000 kg.

**FORMULA USED:**

Weighted avg = (n₁ × average of n₁ quantity + n₂ × average of n₂ quantity + ----)/(n₁ ₊ n₂ +------)

**CALCULATION:**

Weighted average = 4000kg.

Let remaining vehicle = x.

Using formula, we get 4000 = frac{{12 × 6000 + x × 3000}}{{12 + x}}

→ 48000 + 4000x = 72000 + 3000x

→ 1000x = 24000

→ x = 24

Total number of vehicles = 24 + 12 = **36**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] **

Let number of remaining vehicle be x

Total number of vehicle = x + 12

⇒ 4000 (x + 12) = (6000 × 12) + (x × 3000)

⇒ 4000x + 48000 = 72000 + 3000x

⇒ 1000x = 24000

⇒ x = 24

Total number of vehicles = 24 + 12 = **36**
